_comment: GitHub Personal Access Token templates. Add the credential first (harness vault add github/work), then add these templates.

gh_cli_env.name: gh_cli_env
gh_cli_env.description: Inject as GH_TOKEN env var for the gh CLI
gh_cli_env.cli: harness vault template add github/work --name gh_cli_env --env '{"GH_TOKEN": "$value"}'

gh_cli_all_env.name: gh_cli_all_env
gh_cli_all_env.description: Inject as GH_TOKEN plus GITHUB_TOKEN (some tools want both)
gh_cli_all_env.cli: harness vault template add github/work --name gh_cli_all_env --env '{"GH_TOKEN": "$value", "GITHUB_TOKEN": "$value"}'

ssh_key_file.name: ssh_key_file
ssh_key_file.description: Write the token as a key file for SSH-based git access
ssh_key_file.cli: harness vault template add github/work --name ssh_key_file --wrapper 'GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i /tmp/harness-github-key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no" {original}'

curl_bearer.name: curl_bearer
curl_bearer.description: Wrap curl commands with Authorization header
curl_bearer.cli: harness vault template add github/work --name curl_bearer --wrapper "curl -H 'Authorization: token \$value' {original}"

api_basic_auth.name: api_basic_auth
api_basic_auth.description: Wrap curl commands with HTTP Basic Auth header
api_basic_auth.cli: harness vault template add github/work --name api_basic_auth --wrapper "curl -u 'user:\$value' {original}"
